_comment: Whole-store refusal baseline for ACS-100i-7. Records the refusal messages that are NOT attributable to the top-level package-surface if/then rule. The guard test asserts this set is byte-identical: none added, none removed, no message changed. A shrunken set normally means validation was loosened generally instead of the trigger narrowed. REGENERATED 2026-09-01: the previous 28-record baseline was measured at 969d7bc0, and ALL 28 of its entries were the same defect — test_spec entries rejected for declaring `framework: vitest` (26), `framework: playwright` (2), or `type: component` (9 of those 28), against enums that predate leafcutter-web and so could not name the frameworks this repo actually runs. Those enums were widened in the immediately preceding commit, in BOTH config/ac_store_schema.json and config/test_requirements.schema.json, so all 28 records now validate. Their disappearance is a vocabulary repair, not a loosening: the guard run that produced this file reported Added: [] and Messages changed: [] — only removals, and only these 28. See KI-ACS-010. Regenerate ONLY in a commit that can point at the record edit explaining each removal; never to make a red assertion go green.

supersedes.reason: All 28 entries were test_spec framework/type enum refusals, resolved by widening both schemas to name vitest, playwright and component.
